plan: Queue midlane as primary. It is Goldilocks324's best role at 53.3% over 176 games (overall is 52.3%). Set carry as secondary, not the other way around.
Two-hero rule for the climb: Kira and Iggy & Scorch. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Goldilocks324 wins about 4.9 and 4.0 more games per 100 on them.
Goldilocks324's champion pool is 19+ heroes wide and the top three are only 29% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Goldilocks324 is at 730 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 922 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why
